title: Fast-paced montage of cash targets, tile flips, and orange swipe trails

clips.why: Opens on the cash counter, fox mascot, and target word rewards
Sped-up taps and swipes showing responsive tile flip feedback
Fast cut of tapping individual S-U-N tiles on the 4x4 grid
Highlights the orange line trail connecting adjacent letters
Clean diagonal and horizontal swipes at full speed
Vertical swipe down the left column and bottom row check
Peak-motion burst of consecutive drags to close the montage
